Use case: productivity-visual / scientific-educational. Create ONE finished Chinese university course slide as a high-resolution raster sample, 4:3 landscape, ideally 1448x1086 or higher same ratio. Input image 1 is ONLY the STYLE AND MASTHEAD reference. Preserve the entire light-blue masthead occupying top 13.5%, original left course name “大数据与生成式AI”, right BUPT emblem and Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications Chinese/English wordmark, exact proportions and branding. Replace every part below masthead. Match refined blue-white academic keynote style, white background, navy #07365D large bold titles, azure #168CCE subtitles, restrained pale-blue semantic diagram backgrounds, slate-blue body text. Modern Chinese sans-serif. Strong editorial hierarchy, precise alignment, legible real content, balanced information density. Flat scholarly composition, no dashboard tile grid, heavy shadows, pointless decorative icons, 3D robots or sci-fi brains. Do not add URL/source-credit footers. If reproducing a research figure, show compact author-year attribution as part of its figure label. No invented real deployment, performance data, or fabricated photographs. Only finished slide, no mockup frame. Chinese text must be accurately typeset.
SLIDE13 title: AI概念之间的关系
Subtitle: 先区分研究领域、技术方法与生成任务，再理解大语言模型
Main visual is a clear concept relationship map, not a misleading five-level nesting.
LEFT roughly52%: three large nested outlined regions in successively deeper blues. All labels readable:
outer “人工智能 AI” with descriptor “实现感知、推理与决策等能力”;
middle “机器学习 ML” with descriptor “从样本中学习规律”;
inner “深度学习 DL” with descriptor “使用多层神经网络学习表示”.
In the AI area outside ML, include small short label “也包含规则与知识推理”.
RIGHT roughly43%: linked topic region titled “生成式AI：以生成内容为目标”. Connect from DL region with one thin straight arrow caption “现代主流实现”. Inside this right region two horizontal branches with clean symbols (small text/code icon and image/audio icon):
“大语言模型 LLM” / “本课聚焦生成式语言模型” / “对话、写作与代码生成”
“图像及其他模态” / “图像、音频与视频生成”
Do not imply every language model is generative or generativeAI is exclusively text. Do not imply the five terms are synonyms.
Under main map two concise side-by-side application comparisons with simple appropriate pictograms:
“识别与预测” / “判断邮件是否为垃圾邮件”
“内容生成” / “根据要求起草一封邮件”
One compact teaching note just above footer:
“图示是现代主流技术的简化关系，不覆盖全部历史方法。”
Bottom bold takeaway:
“AI是领域，机器学习与深度学习是方法，生成式AI强调生成目标。”
Page number13 bottom-right. Prefer semantic diagrams over unrelated stock photos on this specific conceptual page. Every region must have generous internal padding, no crowded mini labels.

SLIDE14 title: 从规则到机器学习
Subtitle: 同样识别垃圾邮件，一种由人写条件，一种从标注样本中学习
Main comparison: two clearly separated horizontal process lanes or two broad editorial columns, with the same email-classification outcome. Compact realistic EMAIL LIST visual is permitted as an explicit teaching scenario, no real brand or personal information. No fake photographs.
Lane/column1 heading “规则方法：人工写条件”
A clean conditional example:
“若包含‘中奖’且含陌生链接”
followed by “按预设条件判断” and result label “疑似垃圾邮件”.
Small supporting line “规则直观，但需持续维护；关键词也可能出现在正常邮件中。”
Lane/column2 heading “机器学习：从样本学规律”
Use a legible 4-row fictional feature table, label “标注样本（教学构造）”
Columns: 邮件摘要 | 陌生链接 | 人工标签
Rows exactly:
会议资料已发送 | 无 | 正常
中奖后请立即领取 | 有 | 垃圾
中奖结果公示通知 | 无 | 正常
高额回报，点击加入 | 有 | 垃圾
Below table a short precise pipeline with arrows:
“训练样本与标签” → “训练分类模型” → “新邮件预测”
Supporting line “模型综合多种特征；预测效果要用未参与训练的数据检验。”
A full-width slim lower section with heading “现实系统常把两者组合”
Text “明确的安全规则 + 分类模型 + 用户反馈”
Closing bold takeaway “从逐条编写判断条件，转向利用样本优化预测。”
Bottom corner page14.
Keep exact table and key comparison readable. Use navy/azure two-tone treatment, pale-blue linework, no numerical success claims. Clearly mark all sample email content as fictional teaching examples, do not mimic a screenshot of an actual deployed mailbox. Fit comfortably without crowds.

SLIDE15 title: 深度学习的转折点
Subtitle: 2012年AlexNet：数据、深层网络与GPU计算形成合力
Input2 is a GENUINE PDF page with AlexNet Figure4; input3 is the genuine research-paper first page. Reuse actual photographs from input2 (e.g. container ship, leopard, car), cleanly cropped as classification examples. Preserve photographic subjects and appearance, no newly invented photos. Do not copy surrounding paper prose. Use the paper title from input3 as a small readable research-title strip or carefully cropped paper-heading facsimile, not a whole unreadable page.
Main LEFT roughly55%: 2012 year in strong azure, then research title in readable small text:
“ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks”
“Alex Krizhevsky · Ilya Sutskever · Geoffrey E. Hinton”
Under it three original photo thumbnails from Figure4 labelled in Chinese “集装箱船”“豹”“汽车”, with a simple classification flow:
“输入图片” → “多层网络提取特征” → “预测类别”
One clear definition:
“表示学习：让模型从训练数据中学习特征，而不只依赖人工设计。”
Caption directly beneath photos “分类样例节选自Krizhevsky等，2012，图4”
RIGHT roughly40%: heading “为什么成为重要节点”
Three compact meaningful explanatory rows, not decorative floating tiles:
“数据” / “大规模标注图像支持训练”
“网络” / “深层卷积网络逐层学习视觉特征”
“计算” / “GPU加速使大规模训练可行”
Below these a small exact two-bar comparison, include metric and evaluation scope clearly:
“ILSVRC-2012 Top-5测试错误率”
“第二名 26.2%”
“获胜方案 15.3%”
Bars start from zero, value26.2 bar longer than15.3. Use navy for15.3 and pale blue26.2, do NOT reverse. Lower is better. If little room, prefer exact numeric pair with labels over elaborate chart.
Compact clarification under benchmark “Top-5：前5个预测中未包含正确类别的比例。”
Final bold line “这是图像分类的重要突破，不能据此推断所有任务都已超过人类。”
Page15. No additional giant photo background, fake GPU image, false claim of human-level AI, or conflation of ILSVRC-2010 and2012. All source-image figures only as provided above, no wholesale reproduction of paper paragraphs. Balanced rich informative slide.

SLIDE16 title: Transformer的出现
Subtitle: 2017年，注意力机制成为连接序列信息的核心
Input2 is the GENUINE original-paper Figure1, and input3 is genuine first page. Reuse the exact Figure1 architecture artwork as a carefully cropped genuine figure on LEFT, preserving colored boxes, arrows, original labels, encoder/decoder direction. Crop surrounding body prose away. Do not redraw a fabricated architecture. Put readable caption “原论文结构图｜Vaswani等，2017，图1” under it. A research-heading strip above reads “2017  Attention Is All You Need”.
Main RIGHT roughly55% is an accessible conceptual self-attention example with generous space:
heading “注意力：结合上下文，关注相关位置”
Sentence exactly “小李把书放进书包，因为它很轻。”
Represent its relevant phrase tokens clearly in a horizontal row or two aligned rows, with “它” emphasized and a small number of thin connections back toward “书”“书包”, different weights visually. This is explicitly a conceptual ambiguity example, no claiming one unique interpretation and no invented measured weights.
Small annotation beneath diagram:
“‘它’指什么？需要结合上下文；此图仅为原理示意，并非实测权重。”
Two concise mechanism explanation rows:
“自注意力” / “同一序列的不同位置交换信息，形成上下文表示。”
“多头与位置” / “多个头学习不同关联；位置信息帮助表达先后顺序。”
A slim lower timeline clarifies evolution:
“2017：机器翻译研究” → “后续：预训练语言模型与多模态模型”
One bold closing takeaway:
“Transformer是一类模型架构，今天的大模型来自此后的持续发展。”
Page16. Do not imply2017modelalreadyChatGPT, do not equate attention to human understanding, do not claim inference all output tokens parallel or zero delay. No matrix derivation. Original architecture should be large enough to see, right side diagram should be explanatory, clean layout, no crowding. Attribute the reused figure compactly as specified rather than a general sources footer.
